data.body: AC amendment: Round-trip test (onboarding→migrator→no-op) is a cross-story integration concern. It requires S2 (6748-7ceb-1383-4ce5) to be merged first. The round-trip test should be added to S2's test suite, not this story. When implementing T2, add a comment in SKILL.md noting that the written config grammar (bare dso.workflow=<value>, LF endings, no quotes) is designed to be accepted by the migrator as already-migrated (idempotency contract). This ensures the grammar documentation is in place even though the full round-trip test lives in S2.
